office_does: A Ferry County PUD No. 1 commissioner sits on the three-member board that runs the electric utility serving Ferry County; on Okanogan's ballot the race appears only for about 325 northeastern voters who are inside Ferry PUD.
race_blurb: Incumbent Doug Aubertin, seeking a fourth term, cites $5 million in grants and opposes state electric-vehicle mandates; retired mining executive and former Colville Tribal Enterprise Corporation COO Andrew Pooler pledges dependable, low-cost power. Nonpartisan.

candidates.summary: Ferry County PUD No. 1 commissioner (Position 3) since 2009 by his account, a Keller logger and rancher seeking a fourth term.
highlights: Says he helped the PUD win $5 million in grants for line extensions and underground line [S1]
Says state electric-vehicle mandates 'do not fit well in our rural environment' [S1]

candidates.summary: Retired mining executive and former chief operating officer of Colville Tribal Enterprise Corporation, running for his first elected office.
highlights: 35 years as a mining executive responsible for 16 large-scale mines [S1]
Pledges 'dependable and low-cost electricity to all PUD customers' [S1]
Cites experience with high-voltage line construction and budget management [S1]
